scope: Standalone v46 web runtime; no v45 source or detector fallback
source_policy: Runtime files copied byte-for-byte from src

excluded_legacy_modules.1_point_detection_v3.py: Legacy trained ViT detector; web v46 dispatch always selects grid_v46.
excluded_legacy_modules.chart_marker_detector_v3.py: Legacy training/ViT model; current correction receives detected points.
excluded_legacy_modules.segment_detector.py: Only referenced as a command-line display name; actual loader uses 3_segment_detection_v2.py.
excluded_legacy_modules.3_segment_detection.py: Fallback only if 3_segment_detection_v2.py is missing; v2 is always packaged.
excluded_legacy_modules.5_correction_v2.py: Only the excluded legacy ViT branch loads this correction engine; v46 uses bw_series_correction_v46.
